about: NOT INSTALLED (removed after round 2, 2026-11-10). vercel-labs/agent-desktop 1.2.0 (npm, unsigned native x64 binary). launchd socket-activated LaunchAgent com.vmlab.agent-desktop runs `agent-desktop mcp` per connection on the VM's 127.0.0.1:8010 inside the GUI session (the binary holds Accessibility + Screen Recording); the host bridges stdio with ssh -W (vm-mcp-tcp).
